from clearml.automation.controller import PipelineController
pipeline = PipelineController(name="Function \"golden\" pipeline")
pipeline.add_parameter(name="prefix", default="a\\b\"c")
pipeline.add_function_step(name="split_data", signature="def split_data(value, prefix=\"\") -> tuple[int, int]", source="def split_data(value, prefix=\"\"):\n    return value, value\n", execution_queue="cpu-a", cache=True, packages=["pandas==2.2.3"], retry_on_failure=3, outputs=["left", "right"])
pipeline.bind(kind="parameter", source="parameter:prefix", target="split_data.prefix")
pipeline.publish_output(name="left_result", source="split_data.left")
